description: Source code for a Git daemon implementation, handling network connections, repository access, and service management.

classes.name: hostinfo
classes.description: Structure holding hostname, IP address, and TCP port information for a client connection.

classes.name: child
classes.description: Structure representing a child process handling a network connection, including process info and client address.

classes.name: socketlist
classes.description: Structure managing a list of socket file descriptors for listening.

classes.name: credentials
classes.description: Structure holding user credentials for privilege dropping.

classes.name: daemon_service
classes.description: Structure defining a service handled by the daemon, including name, function, and configuration flags.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the daemon command, parsing arguments and starting the server or inetd mode.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Sets up listening sockets, drops privileges, and enters the service loop.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles a single connection in inetd or serve mode, processing protocol commands.

methods.name: parse_host_and_port
methods.description: Parses a host:port string into separate host and port components.

methods.name: sanitize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes a client-supplied string for filesystem path safety.

methods.name: canonicalize_client
methods.description: Sanitizes and converts a client string to lowercase for canonical form.

methods.name: lookup_hostname
methods.description: Resolves hostname to canonical name and IP address.

methods.name: hostinfo_clear
methods.description: Releases resources associated with hostinfo structure.

methods.name: set_keep_alive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive on a socket.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Adds a child process to the list of active children, tracking its address.

methods.name: kill_some_child
methods.description: Kills a duplicate connection when maximum connections are exceeded.

methods.name: check_dead_children
methods.description: Reaps zombie child processes and cleans up.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles an incoming connection, spawning a child process to serve it.

methods.name: child_handler
methods.description: Signal handler for SIGCHLD, empty as system calls are interrupted.

methods.name: set_reuse_addr
methods.description: Sets SO_REUSEADDR socket option.

methods.name: socksetup
methods.description: Creates listening sockets based on configuration.

methods.name: service_loop
methods.description: Main loop accepting and handling incoming connections.

methods.name: setup_named_sock
methods.description: Creates and binds a socket for listening on a specified address and port.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a socket address to a human-readable IP string.

methods.name: parse_extra_args
methods.description: Parses additional arguments sent after the main protocol line.

methods.name: run_access_hook
methods.description: Runs an external hook script to authorize access.

methods.name: run_service
methods.description: Executes a specific service command after validation.

methods.name: enable_service
methods.description: Enables a named service.

methods.name: make_service_overridable
methods.description: Sets whether a service can be overridden by configuration.
